Summaries, grades, ratings, rumor tiers, needs and board rankings and analysis are written by Black & Gold Dispatch: credit 'Black & Gold Dispatch' and link to the original publisher (the `url` field). College prospect stats come from CollegeFootballData.com (https://collegefootballdata.com): credit 'Data: CollegeFootballData.com'; we grant no rights in their data.
